name: World
vision_statement: What lies beyond a person's Quest reaches the AI through one measured path.
opportunities: Models, search backends and tools change faster than the assistant does, so reaching them through one measured path lets the best one run as they move.
solution_coherence: World is how the assistant learns what is outside it and acts on it. Model Plumbing asks a model through one measured path, where Model Tier Chooser picks the model for each tier and Vendor Model Caller asks that vendor. Tools lets the assistant use the tool of each category the person's authority allows, through Web Search, File Editing and Delegated Agent Sessions. Science answers from public research with its sources.
